strings.Usage: TuxBloxInstaller [options]\n\nIns:
Usage: TuxBloxInstaller [options] Installs TuxBlox, upgrading an existing install in place if one is found, then starts the TuxBlox Launcher. Installs into ~/.tuxblox unless --dir says otherwise. Installs the newest release on its channel unless told otherwise. Options: --dir Absolute path to install into, instead of ~/.tuxblox. --allow-root Allow installing as root, which is not recommended. --headless Report progress on the terminal instead of opening a window. Needs no display. --nolaunch Don't start the launcher once the install finishes. --uninstall Remove TuxBlox from this system instead of installing it. --channel Release channel to install from (default: the channel this installer was built for). --release Install a specific release, e.g. 3.6.0.1, instead of the newest one. --release-file

Install the release described by a file already on disk. Used by the launcher when it hands over an update it has already resolved. --language Interface language: en, pt_BR or es. --latest Accepted and ignored: installing the newest release instead of this installer's own version. --version Show the build version and exit. -h, --help Show this help and exit.
strings.Usage: TuxBloxLauncher [--update-roblox:
Usage: TuxBloxLauncher [--update-roblox | --install-roblox | --preview-rbxinstaller]

  --update-roblox         Install the channel's newest version if it is missing.
                          Shows no window unless there is something to download.
  --install-roblox        Install the Roblox version the environment describes.
  --preview-rbxinstaller  Show the window without downloading or writing anything.
  --help                  Show this message.
  --version               Print the TuxBlox version and exit.

Environment:
  TUXBLOX_BOOTSTRAPPER_DOWNLOAD_SERVER      Mirror to download from.
  TUXBLOX_BOOTSTRAPPER_DOWNLOAD_RBXHASH     Exact version, or blank for newest.
  TUXBLOX_BOOTSTRAPPER_DOWNLOAD_RBXCHANNEL  Roblox release channel.
  TUXBLOX_BOOTSTRAPPER_DOWNLOAD_APP         player or studio.
  TUXBLOX_BOOTSTRAPPER_INSTALL_DIR          Where versions are installed.
